content:
Just weeks after announcing a price increase for Apple Music, Apple today announced a price hike for Apple TV as well. Apple confirmed to 9to5Mac that the Apple TV monthly fee will rise from US$12.99 to US$14.99.

The Apple One Individual plan will also see a price increase.

Apple TV and Apple One price increase details

Here are the price increase details:

  • Apple TV (monthly): US$14.99 (original price US$12.99)
  • Apple TV (annual): US$119 (original price US$99)
  • Apple One Individual: US$21.95 (original price US$19.95)

Other Apple One plan prices remain unchanged. When Apple raised Apple Music prices last month, it also adjusted the prices of the Apple One Family plan and Apple One Premier plan at the same time, but did not raise the Individual plan fee at that time.

The new pricing takes effect today for new subscribers. Apple said existing subscribers will receive a price increase notification about a month before the new pricing takes effect.

The last time Apple raised the Apple TV price was in August 2025, when the monthly fee was increased from US$9.99 to US$12.99. At that time, Apple did not adjust the annual plan or Apple One bundle pricing.

Over the past year, Apple has significantly expanded the Apple TV content lineup. Last October, Apple announced it had become the exclusive broadcast partner for F1 in the United States. F1 live streaming is included in the standard Apple TV subscription fee at no extra charge.

Earlier this year, Apple also added the Major League Soccer (MLS) streaming service to Apple TV at no extra charge. Previously, users had to subscribe to MLS Season Pass separately to watch MLS matches.

Apple has also benefited from the strong performance of several recent productions, such as the fourth season of "Ted Lasso." The second season of "Dark Matter" premieres on Apple TV today. The sixth season of "Slow Horses" will premiere on September 16.

What do you think of the new Apple TV pricing? Is US$14.99 reasonable given the content Apple TV offers? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
